multiplechoiceresponse.p: Which notice is useful to the person affected?

choice.div: "Our system drafts a summary of your application; a named reviewer makes the decision; you can ask for the reasons and appeal to [route]."

div.p: The specific notice says what is assisted, who decides, and how to challenge it.

multiplechoiceresponse.p: What is a usable explanation of a decision to the person affected?

choice.div: A plain-language account of the factors that mattered and what would have changed the outcome.
A chart of model feature weights.

div.p: Explanations are for people. Internal weights are not an account a person can use or contest.

multiplechoiceresponse.p: Before deploying productivity monitoring, which question matters most?

choice.div: What decision will this data inform, and have the affected people been told and heard?
Whether the vendor has a good dashboard.
Whether the tool can monitor more than competitors'.

div.p: Monitoring is a decision about people. Purpose, notice and voice come before features.

choiceresponse.p: Which belong in a disclosure notice? Select all that apply.

choice.div: The specific task that is assisted.
What the system does not decide.
The route to question or appeal a decision.
The date of the last review.

div.p: Task, limits, challenge route and review date are the content. Marketing claims do not inform the person affected.
